setup.title: Start with a theme
setup.description: Turn scattered notes into readable, traceable knowledge. Create a theme per direction; sources and generated knowledge stay independent.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: {{count}} sources selected. After organizing, you can view related knowledge pages and the original evidence.
sources.autoToggle: While the knowledge panel is open, automatically process changes in scope
sources.scopeHint: Markdown and plain text are supported. Picking a folder includes its files; children follow the folder and cannot be unchecked individually.
sources.previewExcluded: {{count}} stopped sources are excluded; {{eligible}} will actually be processed.
sources.goalRequired: Please enter a goal for the knowledge base.
sources.needOne: Please select at least one supported source.
sources.noticeSavedOnly: Scope saved. No organizing was started by this save; use "Organize / update".
sources.noticeOrganizeError: This run did not finish; see the error below.
sources.noticeDone: This run finished; see the results below.
sources.pendingStop: Stops after the current source finishes; completed results are kept.
sources.relatedTitle: Knowledge pages related to processed sources
sources.noRelated: Sources processed but no related knowledge pages; check the source content or the processing details.
sources.emptySources: Click "Add sources" to pick files or folders, then save and organize.
sources.stopTrackingTitle: Stop processing future changes; keep knowledge and historical evidence
sources.stoppedNotice: Tracking stopped; existing knowledge and historical evidence are kept.
sources.goReviews: Go to reviews · {{count}} involve this source

ask.eyebrow: Based on the current knowledge base
ask.title: Ask the knowledge base
ask.description: Find evidence across topics and original sources, and check the citations behind each answer.
ask.stopHint: Stopping takes effect after the current turn; evidence already found is kept.
ask.noEvidence: No evidence was found to support an answer. You can:
ask.placeholderFirst: Search the current knowledge base's pages and sources…
ask.hint: Enter to ask · Shift + Enter for a new line
ask.stopTitle: Stop and return the evidence found so far
ask.notBuilt: The current theme has not been built yet

status.staleVersion: Current file differs from the ingested version
status.pendingReviews: {{count}} revisions pending review on this page (body may be outdated; see the reviews page for the diff)

retrieval.cancelled: Retrieval stopped; returning the evidence found so far.
retrieval.timeLimit: Reached the {{seconds}}s retrieval time limit; returning the evidence found so far.
retrieval.roundLimit: Reached the maximum retrieval rounds ({{rounds}}); returning the evidence found so far.
retrieval.parseError: The model returned unparseable actions repeatedly; retrieval terminated.
retrieval.done: The model judged the evidence sufficient.

reviews.title: Review revisions
reviews.description: Check proposals against the original evidence, then decide how to update your knowledge.
reviews.emptyHint: AI only proposes, never overwrites, pages you have edited; content matching a deletion intent shows up here as a restore proposal.

reason.user-edited: Body revision · the target page was edited by you; the AI append below is unconfirmed and does not rewrite the body until you accept it.
reason.restore-suggestion: Restore proposal · you deleted this content from the page (deletion intent recorded); new sources support it again. Restoring needs your confirmation; keeping the deletion leaves things as they are.
reason.add-ref: Add citation · new sources support the existing claim below again (corroboration). Accept = append a source citation to that claim; no duplicate body text, no rewriting.

reviews.bodyReadFailed: Failed to read the topic page; cannot compare.
reviews.proposalAddRef: Existing claim that will get a citation
reviews.applyTitleRestore: Write the content back, renumber citations, and release the matching deletion intent
reviews.applyTitleAddRef: Append a source citation to the existing claim; the body is not rewritten
reviews.applyTitleEdit: Written by the program, with the page version re-checked
reviews.applyEditedTitle: Submit the text you edited above; citations follow the original proposal and version checks are unchanged

reader.overviewDescTopics: {{count}} knowledge pages organized. Open one to read, and follow citations back to the original sources.
reader.overviewDescEmpty: Organize knowledge from your sources and turn scattered information into structure.
reader.relatedNone: Open the page to check the original evidence
reader.emptyFirst: Add the first source to this theme
reader.emptyHint: Organized knowledge pages appear here. While reading, click a citation marker to check the original text and version.
reader.saveTitle: Write back to the page (user edit: later AI appends require review)
reader.cancelTitle: Discard changes and return to reading
reader.metaEdit: Editing the raw file; citations and version info refresh after saving
reader.metaRead: Click a paragraph citation to see the source
reader.refsUnavailable: Citation info is temporarily unreadable; the body is still readable.
reader.readError: Cannot read the topic file. Check the knowledge storage directory.
reader.noBody: This topic has no body yet; click "Edit page" above to add some.
reader.citeNotFound: Source info for this citation was not found.
reader.sourceRemovedNote: Source removed (tracking stopped); below is the historical text kept at citation time.
reader.currentStopped: Current version: tracking stopped, the current file is no longer read.
reader.stale: (source updated; the citation is based on the older version)
reader.verifyTitle: The model reads the cited source text and the current claim to judge whether the source supports it
reader.statusUnverifiedHint: : the paragraph was edited; whether the source still supports it is unchecked.
reader.statusUnsupported: The source does not support this claim
reader.noteSuffix: . The body is kept; rewriting requires review.
reader.statusDeleted: This claim was deleted by you (deletion intent recorded; it will not be restored automatically).
reader.snapshotMissing: The snapshot of the cited version is temporarily unreadable. Check the history files in the knowledge storage directory.

themeDialog.title: New knowledge theme
themeDialog.description: Accumulate knowledge around one direction. Each theme has its own sources, pages, and Q&A.
themeDialog.goalPlaceholder: What do you want to understand from the sources, and what should be distilled?
themeDialog.errorRequired: Please enter the theme name and goal.

scopePicker.emptyVaultTitle: No sources in this vault yet.
scopePicker.emptyVaultHint: Add Markdown or plain text, then pick them here.
scopePicker.noMatchHint: Try part of a file name, or clear the search.

language.label: Output language
language.hint: Language of generated content (pages, answers, verification reasons)

sourceStatus.outOfScope: Removed from scope or file deleted
sourceStatus.newInScope: New source in scope, pending ingest

store.manifestUnreadable: Theme config missing or unreadable; check the theme's manifest.json.
store.nameAndGoalRequired: Please enter the theme name and goal.
store.writeInProgress: The theme is being written; finish or stop that before changing settings.
store.writeInProgressRetry: The theme is being written; retry in a moment.
store.configMissing: Theme config missing; recreate the theme.
store.themeSwitchedSaved: Theme switched; the settings were saved to the original theme.
store.buildWhileSaving: The theme is saving changes; organize again in a moment.
store.appliedRestore: Content restored and citations renumbered; the matching deletion intent was released.
store.appliedAddRef: Source citation added to the existing claim (body unchanged).
store.appliedReview: Revision applied and written to the page.
store.discardedRestore: Deletion intent kept; the restore proposal was discarded.
store.discardedReview: Current body kept; the revision was discarded.
store.refOrTopicMissing: Citation or topic page missing; cannot verify.
store.verifyUnsupported: The source does not support this claim: {{reason}} (body kept; rewriting requires review)
store.topicPageMissing: Topic page missing or unreadable; cannot save.

verify.sourceRemoved: Source removed (tracking stopped); no verification. The historical text can still be checked manually in the citation panel.
verify.snapshotMissingDrift: The snapshot of the cited version is missing and the current source version differs from the cited one; cannot verify.
verify.snapshotMissingDisk: The snapshot of the cited version is missing and the current file content differs from the cited one; cannot verify.
verify.snapshotMissingUnreadable: The snapshot of the cited version is missing and the current source is unreadable.
verify.topicReadFailed: Failed to read the topic page: {{path}}
verify.paragraphMissing: The paragraph carrying this citation can no longer be found in the body (it may have been deleted).
verify.invalidVerdict: The model did not return a valid verification result.

review.stale: The page changed after this revision was proposed; re-compare before applying.
